item.title: Man arrested for rape, sexual abuse of daughter in Taylorsville
item.description: A man was arrested for the rape and sexual abuse of a child in Taylorsville on Thursday, according to Taylorsville Police.

item.title: Hogle Zoo welcomes birth of new giraffe calf
item.description: Utah's Hogle Zoo is welcoming a new member of the family after their 8-year-old giraffe gave birth to a calf on Monday.

item.title: Park City Mayor reflects on the Sundance Film Festival's time in Utah ahead of its final weekend
item.description: Sunday, Feb. 1, will mark the last time that the Sundance Film Festival screenings will fill the theaters along Main St. in Park City. Since finding its home here in 1978, the festival has become a beloved hallmark of Utah. Now, it is time to say goodbye.

item.title: Protesters arrested during anti-ICE protest in Salt Lake City identified
item.description: Court documents have revealed details about three of the four people who were arrested during an anti-ICE protest in Salt Lake City on Friday Afternoon.

item.title: 'He gave humanity to the bear': Man behind the original Utah Jazz Bear dies after battle with pancreatic cancer
item.description: The man who made history as the original Utah Jazz Bear has passed away, and fans across the country are remembering the man behind the mascot.

item.title: Police request public's help in finding missing woman out of Garfield County
item.description: The Garfield County Sheriff's office is requesting the public's help in their search for a missing woman out of Escalante. DeEtte Spencer, 70, has reportedly been missing since Jan. 26, 2026. She was last seen driving a Buick Lucerne with a Utah license plate number E604JU.

item.title: Attorneys for Kouri Richins file second request to move trial after receiving jury questionnaires
item.description: Just ten days before her scheduled trial is scheduled to begin, attorneys for Kouri Richins, the Kamas woman accused of fatally poisoning her husband and later authoring a children's book about navigating grief, have filed a motion to reconsider a change of venue for the trial from Summit County to Salt Lake County.
